These exceed the permitted book relocation. Instruction: The book remains to the right of the vase, as in the source; the expected result places it on the opposite, left side. The requested spatial change is absent. Quality, edited image alone: Structure ✔, natural lighting and reflections ✔, artifact-free ✔, texture fidelity ✔; the glass tabletop, transparent supports, vase and open pages are coherent.

Instruction: The large scissors have slimmer blades but still span far more of the image than the small scissors. The expected result is a green-handled pair matching the small pair in overall size; that size match is absent. Quality, edited image alone: Structure ✔, natural perspective and shadows ✔, artifact-free ✔, texture fidelity ✔; both pairs have coherent loops, blades and metal surfaces without noticeable generation flaws.
